paragraphs.en: Automation foundation model for tiny devices: 2-bit, 8-29 MB, tool calls, ASR, structured extraction and embeddings on phones, wearables, smart homes, robots, cars and microcontrollers.
paragraphs.zh: 面向微型设备的自动化基础模型：2-bit 量化、8-29 MB 大小，支持工具调用、语音识别（ASR）、结构化信息提取与向量嵌入，可运行于手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居、机器人、汽车和微控制器。

paragraphs.en: A foundation model for mobiles, wearables, robots, smart home, automotive and microcontrollers. The whole model is a single 8-29 MB binary built on our Simple Attention Network, and we trade general chat capacity to beat models 10x its size on mobile tool calls and match 2-3x bigger models on extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 一个面向手机、可穿戴设备、机器人、智能家居、汽车和微控制器的基础模型。 整个模型是一个基于我们的 Simple Attention Network 构建的 8–29 MB 单一二进制文件，我们牺牲了通用聊天能力，以在移动端工具调用上击败比它大 10 倍的模型，并在信息抽取上媲比它大 2–3 倍的模型。

sents.en: A foundation model for mobiles, wearables, robots, smart home, automotive and microcontrollers.
sents.zh: 一个面向手机、可穿戴设备、机器人、智能家居、汽车和微控制器的基础模型。

sents.en: The whole model is a single 8-29 MB binary built on our Simple Attention Network, and we trade general chat capacity to beat models 10x its size on mobile tool calls and match 2-3x bigger models on extraction.
sents.zh: 整个模型是一个基于我们的 Simple Attention Network 构建的 8–29 MB 单一二进制文件，我们牺牲了通用聊天能力，以在移动端工具调用上击败比它大 10 倍的模型，并在信息抽取上媲比它大 2–3 倍的模型。

paragraphs.en: Needle 3 is a Laddered Simple Attention Network: a Monarch Hadamard MLP in place of the FFN, GQA attention with causal conv taps, engram n-gram memory read by gather, and multi-lane hyper-connections, trained so that every depth from 2 to 20 layers is a deployable model. Most of its parameters sit in the engram, so the 121M model does the arithmetic of a 50M one. A byte-level grammar compiled from your schemas constrains every token, and every response carries a calibrated confidence score from a learned head. The architecture diagram is on the release page .
paragraphs.zh: Needle 3 是一个阶梯式简单注意力网络：用 Monarch Hadamard MLP 取代 FFN，采用带因果卷积抽头的 GQA 注意力、通过 gather 读取的 engram n-gram 记忆，以及多车道超连接，并通过训练使 2 到 20 层的每个深度都是一个可部署的模型。 它的大部分参数都在 engram 中，因此这个 121M 模型发挥出的是 50M 模型的运算水平。 由你的模式（schema）编译出的字节级语法约束每一个 token，并且每个响应都带有一个来自可学习头部的经校准的置信度分数。 架构图见发布页面。

paragraphs.en: Tool calling is exact-match accuracy on the full test splits, extraction is field micro-F1 on the full test splits.
paragraphs.zh: 工具调用是在完整测试集上的精确匹配准确率，信息抽取是在完整测试集上的字段级微平均F1值。

paragraphs.en: The interactive frontier plot, the architecture and the fine-tuning results are at cactuscompute.com/needle .
paragraphs.zh: 交互式前沿图表、架构以及微调结果请见 cactuscompute.com/needle。

paragraphs.en: Decorate a function: the signature gives the argument types, the docstring is the tool description, and run() completes the loop, executing your function and returning its results.
paragraphs.zh: 装饰一个函数：函数签名给出了参数类型，docstring 是工具描述，而 run() 完成循环，执行你的函数并返回其结果。

paragraphs.en: import needle @ needle . tool def get_weather ( city : str ): "Get the current weather for a city." return { "city" : city , "temp_c" : 27 , "sky" : "clear" } agent = needle . Needle ( tools = [ get_weather ]) print ( agent . run ( "what's it like in Lagos right now?" )[ "results" ]) # [{'city': 'Lagos', 'temp_c': 27, 'sky': 'clear'}] Every turn returns one JSON object with function_calls , the model's reasoning and a calibrated confidence ; an off-topic request returns an empty list rather than a guess. needle.Needle(tools=[...], generation=2) keeps running Needle 2 for existing deployments.
paragraphs.zh: import needle @ needle . tool def get_weather ( city : str )：“获取某个城市的当前天气。” return { "city" : city , "temp_c" : 27 , "sky" : "clear" } agent = needle . Needle ( tools = [ get_weather ]) print ( agent . run (“拉各斯现在天气怎么样？”)[ "results" ]) # [{'city': 'Lagos', 'temp_c': 27, 'sky': 'clear'}] 每一轮都会返回一个 JSON 对象，包含 function_calls 、模型的推理过程和经过校准的置信度；偏离主题的请求会返回空列表而不是猜测。needle.Needle(tools=[...], generation=2) 会继续为现有部署运行 Needle 2。

paragraphs.en: The community-maintained cactus-needle package runs Needle and Whistle in Node.js and browsers using WebAssembly.
paragraphs.zh: 社区维护的 cactus-needle 包使用 WebAssembly 在 Node.js 和浏览器中运行 Needle 和 Whistle。

paragraphs.en: npm install cactus-needle Demo · Examples · npm
paragraphs.zh: npm install cactus-needle 演示 · 示例 · npm

paragraphs.en: Whistle is our speech-to-text model, one 16.9 MB file on the CPU: 16 kHz mono audio of any length, one pass up to 30 seconds and windowed beyond it, in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish. It shares Needle's .cact container, its quantisation and its C++ engine, so the two are one runtime, and its decoder is laddered the same way, with --audio-depth N running the N-layer rung of the same weights.
paragraphs.zh: Whistle 是我们的语音转文本模型，单个 16.9 MB 文件即可在 CPU 上运行：接受任意长度的 16 kHz 单声道音频，一次处理最多 30 秒，超出部分按窗口切分，支持英语、德语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语、荷兰语和波兰语。 它与 Needle 共用 .cact 容器、量化方案和 C++ 引擎，因此两者是同一个运行时，其解码器也以同样的方式分层，--audio-depth N 运行的就是同一组权重的第 N 层阶梯。

sents.en: It shares Needle's .cact container, its quantisation and its C++ engine, so the two are one runtime, and its decoder is laddered the same way, with --audio-depth N running the N-layer rung of the same weights.
sents.zh: 它与 Needle 共用 .cact 容器、量化方案和 C++ 引擎，因此两者是同一个运行时，其解码器也以同样的方式分层，--audio-depth N 运行的就是同一组权重的第 N 层阶梯。

paragraphs.en: import needle print ( needle . transcribe ( "clip.wav" )[ "text" ]) # turn off the kitchen lights Every call returns the text, the language, the milliseconds to the first token and the decoder's tokens per second after it. word_timestamps=True adds each word with its start, end and probability, keywords=[...] favours the names, product words and jargon your users say, and language="de" forces the language instead of detecting it. needle.Whistle() is the same model as an object, for embed(audio) or to hold one tuned .cact . Silence and steady noise return an empty transcript rather than an invented sentence; other sounds, music especially, can still come out as text, so put a voice activity detector or a wake word in front of an always-on microphone. needle.stream(chunks) transcribes live for as long as the microphone runs, committing the words two passes agree on. needle whistle playground transcribes from the microphone, and needle whistle compare puts Whistle next to Whisper and Moonshine on the same clip.
paragraphs.zh: import needle print ( needle . transcribe ( "clip.wav" )[ "text" ]) # turn off the kitchen lights 每次调用都会返回文本、语言、到首个 token 的毫秒数以及解码器每秒生成的 token 数。word_timestamps=True 会附带每个词及其开始时间、结束时间和概率，keywords=[...] 会偏向用户常说的名字、产品词汇和行话，language="de" 则强制指定语言而不是自动检测。needle.Whistle() 是同一模型的类实例形式，可用于 embed(audio)，或加载一个已调好的 .cact。 静音和稳定噪声会返回空转录而不是凭空编造的句子；其他声音，尤其是音乐，仍可能被输出成文字，因此要在常开的麦克风前面加一个语音活动检测器或唤醒词。needle.stream(chunks) 可在麦克风运行期间进行实时转录，只提交两遍都一致的词语。needle whistle playground 可从麦克风转录，needle whistle compare 则能在同一段音频上把 Whistle 与 Whisper 和 Moonshine 进行对比。

paragraphs.en: At 16.9 MB Whistle is 8.6x smaller than Whisper base and 6.6x quicker to the first token. It is ahead on LibriSpeech test-clean and test-other, on SPGISpeech, on Earnings-22 and on the FLEURS average. Whisper base is ahead on TED-LIUM, on AMI and on the MLS average.
paragraphs.zh: Whistle 模型大小为 16.9 MB，比 Whisper base 小 8.6 倍，且首 token 出现速度快 6.6 倍。 它在 LibriSpeech test-clean 和 test-other、SPGISpeech、Earnings-22 以及 FLEURS 平均成绩上领先。 Whisper base 则在 TED-LIUM、AMI 以及 MLS 平均成绩上领先。

paragraphs.en: needle --model needle3.cact --model whistle.cact --tools tools.json --audio clip.wav One engine holds both models: needle_load reads whichever one a .cact carries, and needle_complete takes a clip wherever it takes text. It transcribes, answers the transcript against your tools, and returns one JSON object with the tool calls and the speech fields, the speech ones prefixed audio_ . The transcription stays inside the engine, so audio in and tool calls out is one call, and it favours the option values your schemas enumerate, so a clip that names one is transcribed as the schema spells it.
paragraphs.zh: needle --model needle3.cact --model whistle.cact --tools tools.json --audio clip.wav 一个引擎同时持有两个模型：needle_load 会加载 .cact 所携带的任一模型，而 needle_complete 无论接收音频还是文本都按同一方式处理。 它会先转写，再针对你的工具对转写内容进行应答，并返回一个包含工具调用与语音字段的 JSON 对象，语音字段以 audio_ 为前缀。 转写过程始终在引擎内部完成，因此输入音频、输出工具调用只需一次调用，而且它会优先选择你的 schema 中枚举的选项值，所以当音频中提到某个选项时，转写结果会按 schema 的写法呈现。

paragraphs.en: Whistle fine-tunes locally: LoRA adapters on the attention projections, base frozen, merged at export, 4-bit. It takes training, validation and test JSONL files, each line {"audio": "clip.wav", "text": "...", "language": "pt"} ; a language code outside the seven adds that language, and --tokens takes a file of words or characters to add to the vocabulary, one per line.
paragraphs.zh: Whistle 在本地进行微调：LoRA 适配器作用于注意力投影，基础模型冻结，导出时合并并量化为 4 比特。 它接受训练、验证和测试 JSONL 文件，每行格式为 {"audio": "clip.wav", "text": "...", "language": "pt"}；七个语言代码之外的语言代码会添加该语言，而 --tokens 接受一个包含词语或字符的文件以加入词表，每行一个。

paragraphs.en: pip install " cactus-needle[train] " needle whistle finetune train.jsonl validation.jsonl test.jsonl --tokens tokens.txt --out adapter.safetensors needle whistle build --lora adapter.safetensors --out tuned.cact Guides How to design tools for Needle 3 : one tool per action, names users would say, formats in descriptions, constraints in the grammar, triggers. Leveraging Needle's confidence : what the score measures, what the engine withholds, and routing on act, confirm or refuse. Structured JSON extraction with Needle : the record as the only tool, typed results, classification with enums. Fine-tuning Needle : the data format, the commands, reading the loss, sizing the dataset. Fine-tuning Whistle : the data format, new characters, the commands, how much data a new language needs. Getting the most out of Whistle : input, word timestamps, live transcription, language, keywords, depth, Whistle with Needle. Needle Python docs : the API, the response shape, the behaviour contract, system facts, tool retrieval, offline devices, environments, the CLI. What devices are supported on Needle : every platform folder, the CLI runner, the C API, the browser, WASI, air-gapped setup. paragraphs.en: Needle was designed to be customised. Its capacity is a ladder, and a subnetwork as small as 2 layers, fine-tuned on one product's tools, runs optimally on devices far smaller than the full model needs. Fine-tuning on DroidCall lifts every subnetwork by 18 to 36 points, and from 4 layers up the tuned subnetwork passes DeepSeek V4 Flash, starting at 29M parameters.
paragraphs.zh: Needle 从设计之初就为定制化而生。 它的容量像一架梯子，小到 2 层的子网络，只需在单一产品的工具上进行微调，就能在远小于完整模型所需规格的设备上优化运行。 在 DroidCall 上微调能让每个子网络提升 18 到 36 分，而从 4 层起，微调后的子网络便能超越 DeepSeek V4 Flash，起点仅为 29M 参数。

paragraphs.en: Two ways to fine-tune, from the same package:
paragraphs.zh: 两种微调方式，来自同一个包：

paragraphs.en: pip install " cactus-needle[train] " needle finetune data.jsonl --epochs 10 --out adapter.safetensors needle build --lora adapter.safetensors --layers 8 --out tuned.cact Platform, with a key from the console in NEEDLE_API_KEY . One command uploads the files, trains and scores every size, and downloads the .cact files; once a job is submitted it can also be followed on the dashboard:
paragraphs.zh: pip install " cactus-needle[train] " needle finetune data.jsonl --epochs 10 --out adapter.safetensors needle build --lora adapter.safetensors --layers 8 --out tuned.cact 平台，并在控制台获取密钥后设置为 NEEDLE_API_KEY 。 一条命令即可上传文件、训练并评估所有规模，并下载 .cact 文件；任务提交后，还可以在仪表板上跟踪进度：

sents.en: pip install " cactus-needle[train] " needle finetune data.jsonl --epochs 10 --out adapter.safetensors needle build --lora adapter.safetensors --layers 8 --out tuned.cact Platform, with a key from the console in NEEDLE_API_KEY .
sents.zh: pip install " cactus-needle[train] " needle finetune data.jsonl --epochs 10 --out adapter.safetensors needle build --lora adapter.safetensors --layers 8 --out tuned.cact 平台，并在控制台获取密钥后设置为 NEEDLE_API_KEY 。

sents.en: One command uploads the files, trains and scores every size, and downloads the .cact files; once a job is submitted it can also be followed on the dashboard:
sents.zh: 一条命令即可上传文件、训练并评估所有规模，并下载 .cact 文件；任务提交后，还可以在仪表板上跟踪进度：

paragraphs.en: export NEEDLE_API_KEY=needle_ft_... needle platform generate --tools tools.json --examples 1000 --out ./data needle platform finetune data/train.jsonl data/validation.jsonl data/test.jsonl --suffix smart-home --out ./models from needle . platform import Platform client = Platform () job = client . wait ( client . finetune ([ "train.jsonl" ], [ "validation.jsonl" ], [ "test.jsonl" ], suffix = "smart-home" )) paths = client . download ( job [ "fine_tuned_model" ], "models" , depth = 8 ) Or hand the key to Claude Code or Codex with cactuscompute.com/llms.txt and let the agent run the loop. needle platform jobs | models | files | billing list what the account holds, needle download model-<id> fetches a model by id, and the fine-tuning guide covers the data format and how to read the scores.
paragraphs.zh: export NEEDLE_API_KEY=needle_ft_... needle platform generate --tools tools.json --examples 1000 --out ./data needle platform finetune data/train.jsonl data/validation.jsonl data/test.jsonl --suffix smart-home --out ./models from needle . platform import Platform client = Platform () job = client . wait ( client . finetune ([ "train.jsonl" ], [ "validation.jsonl" ], [ "test.jsonl" ], suffix = "smart-home" )) paths = client . download ( job [ "fine_tuned_model" ], "models" , depth = 8 ) 或者把密钥交给 Claude Code 或 Codex，并附上 cactuscompute.com/llms.txt，让智能体自行运行整个流程。 needle platform jobs | models | files | billing 列出账户中已有的内容，needle download model-<id> 可按 id 获取模型，微调指南则涵盖了数据格式以及如何解读评分。

paragraphs.en: Every deployment target ships a prebuilt engine that loads the needle3.cact weights at start. needle build --platform <folder> [--layers N] fetches that engine and puts the weights beside it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个部署目标都附带一个预构建的引擎，该引擎会在启动时加载 needle3.cact 权重。needle build --platform <folder> [--layers N] 会获取该引擎，并将权重放在其旁边。

paragraphs.en: needle build --platform macos-arm64 needle build --platform linux-arm64 --layers 8 --out ./pi ./macos-arm64/needle --model needle3.cact --tools tools.json --serve The devices guide lists every folder and what ships in it.
paragraphs.zh: needle build --platform macos-arm64 needle build --platform linux-arm64 --layers 8 --out ./pi ./macos-arm64/needle --model needle3.cact --tools tools.json --serve 设备指南列出了每个文件夹及其包含的内容。

paragraphs.en: By default, telemetry is turned on in the binary. To turn it off, set environment variables NEEDLE_TELEMETRY=0 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
paragraphs.zh: 默认情况下，二进制文件中的遥测功能处于开启状态。 要关闭它，请设置环境变量 NEEDLE_TELEMETRY=0 和 DO_NOT_TRACK=1。
